title: NIST Special Publication 800-63A-4 — Digital Identity Guidelines: Identity Proofing and Enrollment
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
current_as_of: NIST SP 800-63A-4 current web edition; supersedes SP 800-63A
provenance: Official NIST publication rendered on pages.nist.gov
claim_supported: Separates identity resolution evidence validation identity verification and enrollment; states that suitability or entitlement decisions are outside the identity-proofing scope
material_limitation: Governs digital identity services and does not establish self-storage contractual authority physical access rights lock-removal permission or legal compliance

title: NIST Special Publication 800-63B-4 — Digital Identity Guidelines: Authentication and Authenticator Management
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
provenance: Official NIST publication rendered on pages.nist.gov
claim_supported: Describes authentication assurance authenticator control lifecycle reauthentication and documented recovery methods for digital identity systems
material_limitation: Governs digital authentication; it does not turn an authenticated account user into the person legally or contractually authorized to remove a physical lock

title: Hand and Power Tools
claim_supported: Hand and power tools can cause severe injuries when used or maintained improperly; tool hazards are addressed by applicable workplace standards
material_limitation: High-level overview only; does not prescribe a self-storage lock-cut procedure identify the correct tool for a specific lock or replace employer hazard assessment training manufacturer instructions or applicable standards

title: Hand and Power Tools — OSHA 3080
provenance: Official OSHA PDF summarizing basic procedures and safeguards for hand and portable power tools
claim_supported: Supports using the right tool inspecting tools training workers following manufacturer instructions controlling the work area and using appropriate protective equipment
material_limitation: Summary booklet and not a substitute for full federal or state-plan standards; not a tool-selection or cutting instruction for a specific lock
